text: 你为那本日记出了个不高的价，原以为它平平无奇，不会有人愿意花大价钱。显然你猜错了：另一个人的名字被叫到，一名金发、眼神明亮的年轻人上前，以明显高于你报价的价格领走了书。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 14
text: You placed a modest bid on the journal, thinking its unremarkable nature would prevent anyone from paying anything resembling a large sum. Clearly, you were mistaken, as another name is called and a bright-eyed and blond-haired youth goes to claim the book for a price that is noticeably more than your offer.
